summary.text: Margaret DeLaRosa represents the 42nd District in the Illinois House of Representatives, to which she was appointed in October 2025.

paragraphs.text: The district includes Downers Grove, Glen Ellyn, Lisle, Lombard and Wheaton.
Before her appointment she was school board president for Glenbard Township High School District 87 and past president of the League of Women Voters of Glen Ellyn.
She holds a B.S. in accounting from DePaul University.
